options.name: death_link
options.description: When you die, everyone who enabled death link dies. Of course, the reverse is true too.

options.name: progression_balancing
options.description:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.

options.name: accessibility
options.description:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.

options.name: shuffle_essential_items
options.description: Shuffle essential Shellipelago progression items.

options.name: shuffle_max_resource_upgrades
options.description: Shuffle max HP and max rounds upgrades.

options.name: add_easy_destructible_checks
options.description: Add destructible tiles as locations.

options.name: enemies_are_checks
options.description: Add defeated enemies as locations.

options.name: enemies_are_hints
options.description: Defeated enemies can create Archipelago hints for useful Shellipelago locations.

options.name: shuffle_shops
options.description: Shuffle shop item locations. Fixed shop progression can still be shuffled when this is off.

options.name: show_essential_pickup_hints
options.description: Show special graphics for essential pickups in the client.

options.name: add_traps_to_pool
options.description: Allow trap items to be placed as rewards. Vanilla trap locations become filler when this is off.

options.name: trap_fill_percentage
options.description: Percentage of filler item slots that will be replaced with traps.

options.name: trap_pool_spawn
options.description: Trap types that can spawn from the trap item pool.

options.name: trap_weights
options.description: Relative weights for traps in the item pool. Set a trap to 0 to prevent it from appearing.

options.name: other_players_can_find_item_pool_drops
options.display_name: Other Players Can Find Item Pool Drops
options.description: Expose item-pool-only drops as Archipelago locations.

options.name: ring_link
options.description:
Sync Rounds with rings in other games that have Ring Link enabled.
As rounds are spent and gained, ring and round counts fluctuate for all players with this option enabled.

options.name: energy_link
options.description: Sync Energy with other clients that have Energy Link enabled.

options.name: trap_link
options.description:
Send linked traps to other players with Trap Link enabled.
If another linked game supports the received trap effect, that game applies the same trap.

options.name: local_items
options.description: Forces these items to be in their native world.

options.name: non_local_items
options.description: Forces these items to be outside their native world.

options.name: start_inventory
options.description: Start with the specified amount of these items. Example: "Bomb: 1"

options.name: start_hints
options.description: Start with these item's locations prefilled into the ``!hint`` command.

options.name: start_location_hints
options.description: Start with these locations and their item prefilled into the ``!hint`` command.

options.name: exclude_locations
options.description: Prevent these locations from having an important item.

options.name: priority_locations
options.description: Prevent these locations from having an unimportant item.

options.name: item_links
options.description: Share part of your item pool with other players.

options.name: plando_items
options.description: Generic items plando.
